newsitem.title: CHINA: China yuan market nearly no trade on Deng death.
newsitem.headline: China yuan market nearly no trade on Deng death.

text.p: Trading on China's local currency interbank market was extremely low in early trade on Thursday due to the death of Chinese paramount leader Deng Xiaoping, traders said.
Thirty minutes after the opening, 20 million yuan of the 30-day contract had traded at an annual rate of 11.52 percent against 11.448 percent at the close on Wednesday.

"Few investors want to trade at this moment with Deng's death casting a shadow of uncertainty over the market," said one trader. "Trading is expected to be very slow with the interest rates moving in a narrow range over the next few days."
